Title: Dr Tashmin Khamis appointed to INQAAHE board of directors
NewsSummary: Dr Tashmin Khamis, Director of Aga Khan University's Network of Quality Assurance and Improvement, has been appointed to the International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education (INQAAHE) board of directors.
NewsContent:
Dr Tashmin Khamis, Director of Aga Khan University's Network of Quality Assurance and Improvement, has been appointed to the International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education (INQAAHE) board of directors. 

This achievement follows the recent acceptance, in June this year, of the University as an associate member of INQAAHE in recognition of the University's excellent work in the area of quality assurance in higher education.

Dr Khamis is a seasoned educationist with academic specialisations in teaching and learning, faculty development, quality assurance and improvement and interdisciplinary qualitative research.

Commenting on her appointment, Dr Khamis said, "Following my appointment as President of the East African Higher Education Quality Assurance Network, INQAAHE recognises the need to extend its representation of the South.  This is a great honour and recognition of the work of the AKU Networks of Quality, Teaching and Learning." 

INQAAHE is a global association of over 200 organizations active in the theory and practice of quality assurance in higher education. The majority of its members are quality assurance regulatory agencies, including those in countries where AKU has campuses. INQAAHE benchmarks quality assurance globally in higher education and all commissions that regulate AKU, such as Higher Education Commission in Pakistan, Commission for University Education in Kenya, Tanzania Commission for Universities, Uganda National Commission for Higher Education and Quality Assurance Agency for Higher Education in the UK belong to INQAAHE.
